mainEntity.name: How long does paint and finish work usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of paint and finish work depends on several factors, including the scope of the project, the size of the area, surface preparation required, and weather conditions for exterior jobs. A single room might take 1-3 days, while an entire exterior could range from one to several weeks. We provide a detailed project timeline after assessing the specific requirements of your property. Unexpected issues like significant dry rot discovery during preparation can extend the timeline.
